in_sanskrit.name: दीप्तिकान
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who illuminates or shines with knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दीप् (Deepti) - light, knowledge, or intelligence, and कान (Kana) - ear, indicating one who listens attentively and understands deeply. Together, the name Deeptikana can be interpreted as one who illuminates or shines with knowledge, or one who has deep understanding and wisdom.
